summary: Applied Digital Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into an Incremental Assumption Agreement that increased its secured revolving credit facility from an undisclosed prior amount to $430 million, with the ability to add up to $550 million. The facility matures May 28, 2029, and bears interest at Term SOFR plus 2.25% or a base rate. This is a routine debt refinancing and not a special situation involving acquisitions, divestitures, or other corporate events. The filing only reports a material agreement and a direct financial obligation, with no change of control, restructuring, or strategic review.
